about: What a correct Control Tower agent concludes for each mock input, using reference/suggested-rules.md and reference/kpi-definitions.md. Use it as an automated test oracle. Values checked on SAP DS4 on 1 Oct 2026; live counts move every day, so test against the sap-responses files, or allow a tolerance against live SAP.

invariants.readOnly: No input leads to a POST, PATCH, PUT or DELETE, or to any MCP write tool. A run's request log holds GET requests only.
invariants.currencies: EUR (YDE1 / YSOD) and RON (YRO1 / YSOR) are reported separately and never added.
invariants.countOnce: A delivery that is both unbilled and awaiting POD is one finding, cause POD (3.4.1), routed to POD Chaser.
invariants.rowCap: A list that returns exactly its cap (100) is reported as incomplete, or paged; the agent never presents 100 as the total.

01-cfo-why-dso-up-norway.eml.subject: country NO (Norway)
01-cfo-why-dso-up-norway.eml.finding: No business partner on DS4 has an address in Norway (A_BusinessPartnerAddress, Country eq 'NO' returns nothing), so no O2C finding belongs to Norway.
01-cfo-why-dso-up-norway.eml.answer: Say plainly that SAP holds no Norwegian customer and no Norwegian finding; the DSO movement on the slide is not explained by O2C documents in DS4: for a person (check the source of the board figure). Optionally list the DSO drivers that do exist, per country: DE, RO, US, CH, JP.
mustNot: invent a Norwegian customer, value or cause
present German or Romanian findings as Norwegian

02-controller-what-blocks-close.eml.rule: S9: deliveries with goods issue in September 2026 are unbilled for more than 14 days

keyFigures.unbilledLegacy: 34 deliveries with goods issue 2019-2025: report separately, they do not decide the September close. 29 of them are teams' Billing due-list items in TEAM-DATA.md (scenario 7; owner = that team), 5 (80000033, 80000184, 80000186, 80000400, 80608730) are owner other

02-controller-what-blocks-close.eml.memo: Follows reference/close-readiness-memo-template.md: verdict first, KPIs per currency, what blocks the close ranked, owners, legacy items separate.
routeTo: 7 Billing Gatekeeper (1 current; legacy items to the owning team's Billing Gatekeeper, the 5 unallocated ones for a person)
02-controller-what-blocks-close.eml.acceptAlso: If the agent reads only the capped lists (100 rows), the verdict is still 'not ready', but the memo must say the unbilled and blocked lists were cut at 100 rows.
